Gold.note: Central bank accumulation and rate cut expectations support upside.

Silver.note: Strong solar panel demand offsets slight recent underperformance versus gold.

Copper.note: Structural supply deficits and robust electrification demand drive bullish outlook.

Uranium.note: Persistent structural supply deficit and strong utility contracting support higher prices.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply and slowing EV demand growth weigh on sentiment.

Nickel.note: Continued Indonesian supply growth and LFP battery substitution pressure prices.

Zinc.note: Mine supply disruptions and tight treatment charges support a constructive view.

Iron Ore.note: Weak Chinese property sector and steel demand offset by resilient seaborne supply.

Coal.note: Peaking thermal demand and ample seaborne supply cap upside potential.

Rare Earths.note: Geopolitical supply risks and long-term EV motor demand provide a slight premium.

Manganese.note: Steady steelmaking demand and intermittent South African logistics constraints.

PGM.note: Balanced view with offsetting weak auto sales and strong long-term hydrogen potential.

Potash.note: Normalized agricultural application rates and stable global supply balance the market.

Aluminum.note: Chinese production caps and rising green energy demand tighten the market balance.

Diversified.note: Balanced exposure to copper and gold offsets weaker iron ore and coal segments.
